g1.label: 1 — a school-leaving ___
g1.why: A school-leaving certificate is the document you get when you finish Year 10.

g2.label: 2 — a vocational ___
g2.why: In an apprenticeship you spend part of the week at a vocational school.

g3.label: 3 — go on to a ___
g3.why: Students who want the Abitur go on to a college or upper school.

g4.label: 4 — a careers ___
g4.why: A careers fair is an event where companies present their training programmes.

g5.label: 5 — free ___ from the agency
g5.why: The employment agency offers tests that show which kind of work might suit you.

g6.label: 6 — take a ___ year
g6.why: A gap year is a year off between school and work or study.

g7.label: 7 — for their whole ___
g7.why: "For their whole life" means for as long as they live.

g8.label: 8 — ask ___ early
g8.why: You ask questions — of teachers, parents and people who already do the job.

g1.label: 1 — it ___ rain
g1.why: You can see the clouds now, so there is present evidence: going to.

g2.label: 2 — I ___ answer it
g2.why: The decision is made at the moment of speaking, so use will.

g3.label: 3 — she ___ to London next Friday
g3.why: The ticket is booked: a fixed arrangement takes the present progressive.

g4.label: 4 — robots ___ do many jobs
g4.why: "I think" plus a prediction about 2050 takes will.

g5.label: 5 — we ___ visit the careers fair
g5.why: They have already registered, so it is an existing plan: going to.

g6.label: 6 — my train ___ at 7.15
g6.why: Timetables take the present simple: the train leaves at 7.15.

g7.label: 7 — ___ you help me?
g7.why: A polite request is made with "Will you...?"

g8.label: 8 — he ___ pass the test
g8.why: This is a prediction based on evidence, so use won't + infinitive.

g1.label: 1 — when I ___ home
g1.why: After when you use the present simple, even for future time.

g2.label: 2 — as soon as she ___ her results
g2.why: After "as soon as" use the present simple, third person singular: receives.

g3.label: 3 — until everybody ___ here
g3.why: After until you use the present tense, not will.

g4.label: 4 — before he ___ his placement
g4.why: After before you use the present simple.

g5.label: 5 — after I finish school, I ___ travel
g5.why: This half is the main clause, so the will belongs here.

g6.label: 6 — if the course ___ too expensive
g6.why: After if you use the present simple; the won't goes in the other half.

g7.label: 7 — when she ___ the room
g7.why: After when you use the present simple: when she enters.

g8.label: 8 — I ___ send you a message
g8.why: This is the main clause, so it takes will; the as-soon-as clause stays present.
